## In the nick of time

**Word Power 38 · English idioms**

### Meaning

At the very last moment; just in time before something bad happens.

### Usage

1. We got there just in the nick of time.
2. We got to the platform in the nick of time, just as the guard was blowing his whistle.

### Your turn

Use “in the nick of time” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
